notes.title: Food Park Manager - Beachside Brunch Update!
notes.notes:
The major update for Food Park Manager is out now!


We're celebrating this release with a sale for the game. Get 25% off Food Park Manager along with this free content update!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193528/26fe2bf3adea68cc8ac3a7491ca35d8fa223d8c9.png"]


Content Update
New Beach side map!

New stall and ingredients.

More decorations and furniture in line with the beach theme.

New soundtrack to chill on the beach!

Difficulty setting and map selection.


Fixes and Improvements
Added a delete option for save game files.

Fixed a bug with keybindings not saving properly after exiting the game.

Fixed an issue with some character models clipping.

Fixed a rare issue with some queue lines being skipped.



All these new content are for FREE! Thank you so much for your continued support. I hope you enjoy the new content. Looking forward to seeing all your new park designs on the beach!



- Justin V.

notes.title: Update Announcement - New Map and Food Stalls!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



First off, I want to thank you for your support and patience. I know it's been quiet on this page but I’m excited to finally share some good news. Food Park Manager is getting a major update!



I want to quickly acknowledge the silence. After launch, the game didn’t quite do as great as I hoped, so I had to take on other work to pay the bills. That said, I’ve still been thinking about the game and working on improvements behind the scenes.



This upcoming update will bring some fresh content and quality-of-life improvements to your parks, including:

A new beach side map!

Tropical and summer themed decorations.

New food items and stalls.

Difficulty slider for those who want a challenge (not relaxing!)

Some quality-of-life features.

Bug fixes and other small improvements.

These updates will all be coming in a few weeks. So please stay tuned!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193528/cc52bd55164c73a365d8683b672cc7ae5ab5532a.png"]



Thank you for sticking around, for your feedback, and for playing. It means a lot, and I’m looking forward to bringing more fun your way soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Performance Optimizations
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for patiently waiting! I'm aware of the performance issues that some players are experiencing. This latest patch aims to address those issues.


 Revamped how optimization was done to the characters (customers especially). Characters that are really far away will either be invisible or have low detailed movement, shadows, and animations. Previously, only their 3D models were affected.
 Optimized some shaders and textures.
 Optimized some animations when far away from the camera.
 Fixed an issue that sometimes caused customers to not despawn until the game was saved or auto-saved.
 Fixed a bug with the building menu UI for certain languages.
 Frame Rate is now capped to 60 by default. Can still be changed in the Options menu.


That's it for now! Please continue to give feedback and bug reports as I'm committed to improving the game.

Cheers!
-Justin

notes.title: Hotfix for Release Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First of all, thanks for the warm reception of Food Park Manager! I'm glad that a lot of people are enjoying it. Don't forget to leave a review as I'd love to hear your thoughts!

Here are a few hot fixes for the game:


 Fixed an bug where the Park Level's text didn't update properly when loading a game.
 Fixed an issue for lower aspect ratio screens that caused certain UI elements to be hidden.
 Fixed a bug where the cat in the sandbox item didn't show when loading a game.


That's all for now. Please feel free to report any bugs or issues you encounter. I'll try to address them ASAP.

Cheers,
Justin

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.6.5
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I just updated the demo with some content and fixes. Here are the patch notes:


 NEW employee level/promotion system.
 Addressed an issue for some users where all game objects were yellow, except for the sky. Please let me know if you still experience this as I am not able to reproduce this issue myself.
 Reworked the umbrella and cover system. They are now separate objects that you can place on tables.
 Added a Gazebo object to demonstrate what can be done with the reworked system.
 Added multiple new gameplay music.
 Fixed the bug where loading a save file would put the camera on the ground initially.
 Fixed a bug where stalls couldn't sell food because it was missing an ingredient that it didn't even need.
 Increased max camera zoom distance.
 Added more preset colors for customization.


Thanks again for playing! Stay tuned for the full release coming soon.

notes.title: Hotfix for demo patch 0.6.0b
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just some quick fixes and adjustments for the latest demo update.


 Added additional keyboard controls for the camera (specifically for those using touchpads and ergonomic mouse).
 Changed object rotation keys to Z and X. Camera rotation is now using Q and E keys.
 Opening the Ingredients Market now pauses the game so you don't miss the new time limit.
 Added notification for when market is open.
 Fixed a bug with the customization wheel buttons sometimes not responding correctly.
 Some minor text corrections.


I hope you're enjoying the demo!

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.6.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First of all, thank you for all the feedback you've given me! It's been really helpful and I appreciate it a lot. Here are the patch notes. Some are based on your feedback and bug reports.


 Restocking ingredients is now limited to 8AM (start of day) and 3PM. This should encourage planning and resource management, while also reducing the "Ingredient stocks are low!" spam.
 Added some storage furniture to compensate for overstocking.
 Added a multi placement tool (Hold Shift).
 Added a disable snapping key (Hold Ctrl).
 Improved the sign customization so that it also expands upwards.
 Fixed a fatal error that resulted in a crash due to a save game issue.
 Fixed color customization of some decorations.
 Fixed an issue where changing colors would sometimes result in misclicks.
 Fixed a bug where audio settings were not saved.
 Adjusted some dialogue texts.
 Some minor optimizations.


I hope you're enjoying the demo!
